Hi Ben,

Thanks for taking our RFP. A couple quick clarifications from the engineering and security squads so we can complete our evaluation:

1) SCIM: Triton uses a multi-tenant directory where some customers require partial user visibility. Do you support attribute-level filtering or tenant-aware SCIM syncs (i.e., server-side filters so we only provision users that match <organization_id> or custom attributes)? If so, please describe configuration points and whether filters can be applied per-group.

2) Admin roles & separation: We need a clear model for delegated admin: who can create org-scoped admin roles, what privileges are available (user management, policy edits, audit logs access), and whether RBAC can be limited at the tenant or route level. Examples: we want a read-only billing admin vs a full tenant owner.

3) Evidence: for procurement we require an evidence bundle (configs, screenshots, and a short runbook) demonstrating SCIM filters in a sample tenant, and an admin-role matrix mapping Redwood roles to permitted actions. Can you confirm you can provide this within 5 business days?

Appreciate a concise reply we can attach to the procurement packet.

Best,
Andrea

Hi Andrea — great questions. Short answers up front, details below and we'll attach the evidence bundle by EOB next Tuesday.

1) SCIM filtering: Yes. Redwood supports server-side SCIM filtering using attribute-based rules and tenant-scoped filters. Filters can be applied at the provisioning connector level (per IdP / per-SCIM-connection) and at the group-sync job level. We support SCIM v2 path filtering and attribute mapping rules.

2) Admin roles & RBAC: Redwood exposes a role-based access model with built-in policies (Owner, Admin, Billing, ReadOnly) plus the ability to create custom roles limited by scope (Global, Tenant, Application). You can create delegated admin roles that are tenant-scoped and restrict actions (create users, activate/deactivate, change quotas, view audit logs). We also support separation of duties via policy guards (e.g., require MFA to perform privileged actions).

3) Evidence: Confirmed — we'll provide: (a) an admin-role matrix PDF mapping roles to allowed API routes/actions, (b) a short runbook + screenshots for applying a tenant-level SCIM filter, and (c) a zipped evidence bundle with example configs.

Next steps: Kimberly will assemble the role matrix and Rishi will capture the SCIM configuration notes and run the sample export. Will send the bundle by Tue 29 Sep EOB PT.

Best,
